headline: Cloud accelerates and profit jumps, but cash burn deepens

kpis.label: AI Cloud and Compute Services revenue

summary_short: Revenue of RMB271.5B rose 10% y/y, and adjusted EBITA of RMB32.6B rose 260%. Free cash flow was an outflow of RMB34.5B versus an outflow of RMB21.8B a year ago.
summary_long: AI Cloud and Compute Services revenue grew 53%, with AI-related product revenue at RMB17.9B (triple-digit growth for a thirteenth quarter). Customer management revenue fell 5% (up 1% like-for-like). Net income of RMB64.4B was lifted by net investment income. Capex was RMB50.5B, up 60%, for AI infrastructure. Cash and liquid investments were RMB487.9B. The company repurchased US$221M of shares and raised HK$80B from a share placing. No numeric guidance given.
confidence_notes: Figures are from the Form 6-K results announcement (Exhibit 99.1), US GAAP, in RMB. Alibaba labels this the September quarter 2026 (its fiscal year ends March), which the shard labels FY2026 Q3. The shard's Yahoo EPS value of 8.1 tagged USD matches non-GAAP diluted EPS per ADS of RMB8.10, so it is a currency mislabel and the release figure was used. Free cash flow y/y change computed from the release's prior-year outflow of RMB21,840M. Net income benefited from net investment income; the release does not itemize it in the highlights.

drivers.metric: AI Cloud and Compute Services revenue
drivers.explanation: Growth reflects broad demand for AI and cloud services; recurring external-customer revenue grew 67%, driven by adoption of AI-related products.
Improved results in Taobao Instant Commerce and Cloud, plus operating efficiencies, partly offset by higher technology investment.
Attributed to higher net investment income and higher income from operations.
Larger cloud infrastructure spending, partly offset by smaller quick-commerce losses and higher customer prepayments for cloud services.
CEO points to full-stack AI commercialization and improved Alibaba E-commerce Group profitability; CFO targets positive free cash flow with disciplined AI investment.
